Load configuration files
- location of model drivers, rds files (containing models), tables of parameter estimates and performance metrics, and figures. 
```{r}
read_properties <- function(file_path) {
  lines <- readLines(file_path)
  lines <- lines[grepl("=", lines)]  # only keep lines with key-value pairs
  key_vals <- strsplit(lines, "=")
  props <- setNames(
    trimws(sapply(key_vals, `[`, 2)),
    trimws(sapply(key_vals, `[`, 1))
  )
  return(props)
}

# *** paleo_config.properties must be in Paleo_Lightning_Fire_Uden_2026
```

```{r}
km2_to_acres <- function(km2) km2 / 0.00404686

setDT(df)

# =============================================================================
# STEP 1: Alaska-wide annual totals, per draw -- burned area now carried in
# BOTH km^2 and acres from the start, so either can be plotted without
# recomputing anything downstream.
# =============================================================================
paleo_annual_by_draw <- df[, .(
  strike_rate_mean       = mean(r_strike, na.rm = TRUE),
  strike_count_total     = sum(n_strikes, na.rm = TRUE),
  ignition_eff_mean      = mean(p_ignite_rate_cal, na.rm = TRUE),
  fire_count_total        = sum(fire_count_pred, na.rm = TRUE),
  burned_area_total_km2   = sum(total_burned_area_capped, na.rm = TRUE)
), by = .(draw_id, year)]

paleo_annual_by_draw[, burned_area_total_acres := km2_to_acres(burned_area_total_km2)]

# =============================================================================
# STEP 2: bin + summarize -- draws-only CI, years collapsed within each
# draw first. Burned area summarized in BOTH units.
# =============================================================================
build_binned_summary <- function(dt, bin_width = 100) {
  d <- copy(dt)
  d[, year_bin := floor(year / bin_width) * bin_width]

  per_draw_bin <- d[, .(
    strike_rate_mean          = mean(strike_rate_mean),
    strike_count_total        = mean(strike_count_total),
    ignition_eff_mean         = mean(ignition_eff_mean),
    fire_count_total           = mean(fire_count_total),
    burned_area_total_km2      = mean(burned_area_total_km2),
    burned_area_total_acres    = mean(burned_area_total_acres)
  ), by = .(draw_id, year_bin)]

  per_draw_bin[, .(
    strike_rate_mean_mean = mean(strike_rate_mean),
    strike_rate_lower      = quantile(strike_rate_mean, 0.025),
    strike_rate_upper      = quantile(strike_rate_mean, 0.975),

    strike_count_mean  = mean(strike_count_total),
    strike_count_lower = quantile(strike_count_total, 0.025),
    strike_count_upper = quantile(strike_count_total, 0.975),

    ignition_eff_mean_mean = mean(ignition_eff_mean),
    ignition_eff_lower      = quantile(ignition_eff_mean, 0.025),
    ignition_eff_upper      = quantile(ignition_eff_mean, 0.975),

    fire_count_mean  = mean(fire_count_total),
    fire_count_lower = quantile(fire_count_total, 0.025),
    fire_count_upper = quantile(fire_count_total, 0.975),

    burned_area_mean_km2  = mean(burned_area_total_km2),
    burned_area_lower_km2 = quantile(burned_area_total_km2, 0.025),
    burned_area_upper_km2 = quantile(burned_area_total_km2, 0.975),

    burned_area_mean_acres  = mean(burned_area_total_acres),
    burned_area_lower_acres = quantile(burned_area_total_acres, 0.025),
    burned_area_upper_acres = quantile(burned_area_total_acres, 0.975)
  ), by = year_bin][order(year_bin)]
}

paleo_century <- build_binned_summary(paleo_annual_by_draw, bin_width = 100)

# =============================================================================
# STEP 3: plotting function -- unchanged from before
# =============================================================================
plot_paleo_outcome <- function(binned_dt, mean_col, lower_col, upper_col,
                                y_label, panel_label, bin_width,
                                year_interval = 200) {

  year_breaks <- seq(
    floor(min(binned_dt$year_bin) / year_interval) * year_interval,
    ceiling(max(binned_dt$year_bin) / year_interval) * year_interval,
    by = year_interval
  )

  ggplot(binned_dt, aes(x = year_bin)) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = year_breaks, color = "grey85", linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = .data[[lower_col]], ymax = .data[[upper_col]]),
                fill = "steelblue", alpha = 0.25) +
    geom_line(aes(y = .data[[mean_col]]), color = "steelblue", linewidth = 0.6) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = year_breaks) +
    labs(title = panel_label, x = "Year",
         y = sprintf("%s\n(%d-yr mean, 95%% CI across draws)", y_label, bin_width)) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1, size = 6))
}

# =============================================================================
# STEP 4: burned-area unit toggle -- set once here, everything below follows
# =============================================================================
ba_unit <- "acres"   # switch to "acres" to plot in acres instead

ba_cols <- if (ba_unit == "km2") {
  list(mean = "burned_area_mean_km2", lower = "burned_area_lower_km2",
       upper = "burned_area_upper_km2", label = "Total burned area (km\u00b2)")
} else {
  list(mean = "burned_area_mean_acres", lower = "burned_area_lower_acres",
       upper = "burned_area_upper_acres", label = "Total burned area (acres)")
}

p_strike       <- plot_paleo_outcome(paleo_century, "strike_rate_mean_mean", "strike_rate_lower", "strike_rate_upper",
                                       "Mean strike rate", "(a)", bin_width = 100, year_interval = 250)
p_strike_count <- plot_paleo_outcome(paleo_century, "strike_count_mean", "strike_count_lower", "strike_count_upper",
                                       "Total strike count", "(b)", bin_width = 100, year_interval = 250)
p_ignition     <- plot_paleo_outcome(paleo_century, "ignition_eff_mean_mean", "ignition_eff_lower", "ignition_eff_upper",
                                       "Ignition efficiency", "(c)", bin_width = 100, year_interval = 250)
p_fire         <- plot_paleo_outcome(paleo_century, "fire_count_mean", "fire_count_lower", "fire_count_upper",
                                       "Total fire count", "(d)", bin_width = 100, year_interval = 250)
p_ba           <- plot_paleo_outcome(paleo_century, ba_cols$mean, ba_cols$lower, ba_cols$upper,
                                       ba_cols$label, "(e)", bin_width = 100, year_interval = 250)

final_fig <- (p_strike / p_strike_count / p_ignition / p_fire / p_ba)

ggsave(file.path(base_path, sprintf("Paleo_Reconstructions/Figure_paleo_time_%s.png", ba_unit)),
       final_fig, width = 12, height = 20, dpi = 300)
```

```{r}
km2_to_acres <- function(km2) km2 / 0.00404686

setDT(df)

# =============================================================================
# STEP 1: Alaska-wide annual totals, per draw -- burned area now carried in
# BOTH km^2 and acres from the start, so either can be plotted without
# recomputing anything downstream.
# =============================================================================
paleo_annual_by_draw <- df[, .(
  strike_rate_mean       = mean(r_strike, na.rm = TRUE),
  strike_count_total     = sum(n_strikes, na.rm = TRUE),
  ignition_eff_mean      = mean(p_ignite_rate_cal, na.rm = TRUE),
  fire_count_total        = sum(fire_count_pred, na.rm = TRUE),
  burned_area_total_km2   = sum(total_burned_area_capped, na.rm = TRUE)
), by = .(draw_id, year)]

paleo_annual_by_draw[, burned_area_total_acres := km2_to_acres(burned_area_total_km2)]

build_binned_summary_dual <- function(dt, bin_width = 100, iqr_probs = c(0.10, 0.90)) {
  d <- copy(dt)
  d[, year_bin := floor(year / bin_width) * bin_width]

  # Per draw, per bin: draw's own century mean + spread of annual values
  # around that mean, for ALL FIVE outcomes
  per_draw_bin <- d[, .(
    draw_mean_strike       = mean(strike_rate_mean),
    draw_p_lo_strike        = quantile(strike_rate_mean, iqr_probs[1]),
    draw_p_hi_strike        = quantile(strike_rate_mean, iqr_probs[2]),

    draw_mean_strikecount   = mean(strike_count_total),
    draw_p_lo_strikecount    = quantile(strike_count_total, iqr_probs[1]),
    draw_p_hi_strikecount    = quantile(strike_count_total, iqr_probs[2]),

    draw_mean_ignition      = mean(ignition_eff_mean),
    draw_p_lo_ignition       = quantile(ignition_eff_mean, iqr_probs[1]),
    draw_p_hi_ignition       = quantile(ignition_eff_mean, iqr_probs[2]),

    draw_mean_fire          = mean(fire_count_total),
    draw_p_lo_fire           = quantile(fire_count_total, iqr_probs[1]),
    draw_p_hi_fire           = quantile(fire_count_total, iqr_probs[2]),

    draw_mean_ba_km2        = mean(burned_area_total_km2),
    draw_p_lo_ba_km2         = quantile(burned_area_total_km2, iqr_probs[1]),
    draw_p_hi_ba_km2         = quantile(burned_area_total_km2, iqr_probs[2]),

    draw_mean_ba_acres      = mean(burned_area_total_acres),
    draw_p_lo_ba_acres       = quantile(burned_area_total_acres, iqr_probs[1]),
    draw_p_hi_ba_acres       = quantile(burned_area_total_acres, iqr_probs[2])
  ), by = .(draw_id, year_bin)]

  # Offsets from each draw's OWN mean
  per_draw_bin[, `:=`(
    offset_lo_strike = draw_p_lo_strike - draw_mean_strike,
    offset_hi_strike = draw_p_hi_strike - draw_mean_strike,

    offset_lo_strikecount = draw_p_lo_strikecount - draw_mean_strikecount,
    offset_hi_strikecount = draw_p_hi_strikecount - draw_mean_strikecount,

    offset_lo_ignition = draw_p_lo_ignition - draw_mean_ignition,
    offset_hi_ignition = draw_p_hi_ignition - draw_mean_ignition,

    offset_lo_fire = draw_p_lo_fire - draw_mean_fire,
    offset_hi_fire = draw_p_hi_fire - draw_mean_fire,

    offset_lo_ba_km2 = draw_p_lo_ba_km2 - draw_mean_ba_km2,
    offset_hi_ba_km2 = draw_p_hi_ba_km2 - draw_mean_ba_km2,

    offset_lo_ba_acres = draw_p_lo_ba_acres - draw_mean_ba_acres,
    offset_hi_ba_acres = draw_p_hi_ba_acres - draw_mean_ba_acres
  )]

  per_draw_bin[, .(
    post_mean_strike  = mean(draw_mean_strike),
    post_lower_strike = quantile(draw_mean_strike, 0.025),
    post_upper_strike = quantile(draw_mean_strike, 0.975),
    interannual_lower_strike = mean(draw_mean_strike) + mean(offset_lo_strike),
    interannual_upper_strike = mean(draw_mean_strike) + mean(offset_hi_strike),

    post_mean_strikecount  = mean(draw_mean_strikecount),
    post_lower_strikecount = quantile(draw_mean_strikecount, 0.025),
    post_upper_strikecount = quantile(draw_mean_strikecount, 0.975),
    interannual_lower_strikecount = mean(draw_mean_strikecount) + mean(offset_lo_strikecount),
    interannual_upper_strikecount = mean(draw_mean_strikecount) + mean(offset_hi_strikecount),

    post_mean_ignition  = mean(draw_mean_ignition),
    post_lower_ignition = quantile(draw_mean_ignition, 0.025),
    post_upper_ignition = quantile(draw_mean_ignition, 0.975),
    interannual_lower_ignition = mean(draw_mean_ignition) + mean(offset_lo_ignition),
    interannual_upper_ignition = mean(draw_mean_ignition) + mean(offset_hi_ignition),

    post_mean_fire  = mean(draw_mean_fire),
    post_lower_fire = quantile(draw_mean_fire, 0.025),
    post_upper_fire = quantile(draw_mean_fire, 0.975),
    interannual_lower_fire = mean(draw_mean_fire) + mean(offset_lo_fire),
    interannual_upper_fire = mean(draw_mean_fire) + mean(offset_hi_fire),

    post_mean_ba_km2  = mean(draw_mean_ba_km2),
    post_lower_ba_km2 = quantile(draw_mean_ba_km2, 0.025),
    post_upper_ba_km2 = quantile(draw_mean_ba_km2, 0.975),
    interannual_lower_ba_km2 = mean(draw_mean_ba_km2) + mean(offset_lo_ba_km2),
    interannual_upper_ba_km2 = mean(draw_mean_ba_km2) + mean(offset_hi_ba_km2),

    post_mean_ba_acres  = mean(draw_mean_ba_acres),
    post_lower_ba_acres = quantile(draw_mean_ba_acres, 0.025),
    post_upper_ba_acres = quantile(draw_mean_ba_acres, 0.975),
    interannual_lower_ba_acres = mean(draw_mean_ba_acres) + mean(offset_lo_ba_acres),
    interannual_upper_ba_acres = mean(draw_mean_ba_acres) + mean(offset_hi_ba_acres)
  ), by = year_bin][order(year_bin)]
}

paleo_century_dual <- build_binned_summary_dual(paleo_annual_by_draw, bin_width = 100)

# ---- ba_unit toggle, same pattern as before ----
ba_unit <- "acres"   #  "acres" or "km2
ba_prefix <- if (ba_unit == "km2") "ba_km2" else "ba_acres"
ba_label  <- if (ba_unit == "km2") "Total burned area (km\u00b2)" else "Total burned area (acres)"

p_strike       <- plot_paleo_dual(paleo_century_dual, "strike",       "Mean strike rate",     "(a)", bin_width = 100, year_interval = 250)
p_strike_count <- plot_paleo_dual(paleo_century_dual, "strikecount",  "Total strike count",   "(b)", bin_width = 100, year_interval = 250)
p_ignition     <- plot_paleo_dual(paleo_century_dual, "ignition",     "Ignition efficiency",  "(c)", bin_width = 100, year_interval = 250)
p_fire         <- plot_paleo_dual(paleo_century_dual, "fire",         "Total fire count",     "(d)", bin_width = 100, year_interval = 250)
p_ba           <- plot_paleo_dual(paleo_century_dual, ba_prefix,      ba_label,               "(e)", bin_width = 100, year_interval = 250)

final_fig <- (p_strike / p_strike_count / p_ignition / p_fire / p_ba)
final_fig

ggsave(file.path(base_path, sprintf("Paleo_Reconstructions/Figure_paleo_time_dual_intervals_%s.png", ba_unit)),
       final_fig, width = 12, height = 20, dpi = 300)
```

Burned Area Cap

```{r}
library(data.table)

# Re-implementation of apply_area_cap(), identical logic, but also
# returning WHICH year each trigger actually occurred in -- this is the
# information the original function computes internally but never exposes.
diagnose_area_cap <- function(df, raw_col = "total_burned_area", recovery_years = 12) {
  n <- nrow(df)
  area <- df$area[1]
  capped <- numeric(n)
  is_trigger_year <- logical(n)
  cumulative <- 0
  recovery_until_year <- -Inf

  for (i in seq_len(n)) {
    this_year <- df$year[i]
    raw_val <- df[[raw_col]][i]

    if (this_year < recovery_until_year || (area - cumulative) <= 0) {
      capped[i] <- 0
      next
    }

    applied_val <- min(raw_val, area - cumulative)
    capped[i] <- applied_val
    cumulative <- cumulative + applied_val

    if (cumulative >= area) {
      cumulative <- 0
      recovery_until_year <- this_year + recovery_years
      is_trigger_year[i] <- TRUE   # <-- the ONLY thing added: flag the true trigger
    }
  }

  df$total_burned_area_capped_check <- capped
  df$is_trigger_year <- is_trigger_year
  df
}

# ---- Rebuild the annual gridcell-draw series (raw, not yet capped) ----
setDT(df)
area_lookup_dt <- as.data.table(area_lookup)  # your existing area_lookup, lat/lon/area

annual_raw <- df[, .(total_burned_area = sum(total_burned_area, na.rm = TRUE)), by = .(draw_id, lat, lon, year)]
annual_raw <- merge(annual_raw, area_lookup_dt, by = c("lat", "lon"))
setorder(annual_raw, draw_id, lat, lon, year)

# ---- Apply the diagnostic version, per gridcell-draw ----
diagnosed <- annual_raw[, diagnose_area_cap(.SD, recovery_years = 12), by = .(draw_id, lat, lon)]

# ---- Now find gaps ONLY between true trigger years ----
trigger_events <- diagnosed[is_trigger_year == TRUE]

fire_years_only <- diagnosed[total_burned_area_capped_check > 0,
                               .(draw_id, lat, lon, year, total_burned_area_capped_check)][
                               order(draw_id, lat, lon, year)]

find_next_fire_year <- function(d_id, la, lo, yr) {
  candidates <- fire_years_only[draw_id == d_id & lat == la & lon == lo]
  after <- candidates[year > yr][order(year)]
  if (nrow(after) == 0) return(list(next_fire_year = NA_integer_, gap_years = NA_integer_))
  list(next_fire_year = after$year[1], gap_years = after$year[1] - yr)
}

trigger_events[, c("next_fire_year", "gap_years") :=
                 find_next_fire_year(draw_id, lat, lon, year), by = seq_len(nrow(trigger_events))]

summary(trigger_events$gap_years)
table(trigger_events$gap_years[trigger_events$gap_years < 12])
```
